sql: SELECT TOP 10 o.ClassNumber AS orderNumber, o.OrderDate AS orderDate, o.Total AS total, c.pendingPaymentCount AS pendingPaymentCount, c.firstOrderNumberAsc AS firstOrderNumberAsc, c.firstOrderNumberDesc AS firstOrderNumberDesc FROM dbo.ZnodeOrder o INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCPOrderClass oc ON oc.CPOrderClassId = o.ClassId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = o.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeOmsOrderState s ON s.OmsOrderStateId = o.OmsOrderStateId CROSS APPLY (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.OrderId) AS pendingPaymentCount, MIN(p.ClassNumber) AS firstOrderNumberAsc, MAX(p.ClassNumber) AS firstOrderNumberDesc FROM dbo.ZnodeOrder p WHERE p.UserId = o.UserId AND p.PortalId = o.PortalId AND p.ClassId = o.ClassId AND p.OmsOrderStateId = o.OmsOrderStateId) c WHERE oc.ClassCode = @approvalClass AND s.StatusCode = @pendingPaymentCode AND po.StoreCode = @store AND (@owner IS NULL OR o.UserId = @owner) AND c.pendingPaymentCount >= @minPendingPayments AND (@maxPendingPayments IS NULL OR c.pendingPaymentCount <= @maxPendingPayments) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR o.ClassNumber = @preferred) ORDER BY o.ClassNumber
